name: Zymogen
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Jesminder Sareen: Girl Behind the Curtain, Kala Ghoda's Shaper identity, which prevents 1 tag the first time each run the Runner would take tags. Dead Reckoning's list, its identity swapped, with two Artist Colony (forfeit an agenda to search the stack for a card and install it), two Liberated Chela (five clicks and an agenda for 2 points, unless the Corp forfeits one) and a Wasteland (a credit the first time each turn the Runner trashes one of their own installs) for two Sacrificial Construct, a Net Shield, a Lampades and a Baker, each kept by Dead Reckoning. Named to sort after every other Runner deck, so the sweep schedule of those before it does not move. Eternal-legal only: Mumbad is in neither pool. FFG F6 Stage 4. Mumbad Stage 15 swapped in Safety First for a Beatriz Friere Gonzalez, which four other decks carry. Mumbad Stage 17: The Price of Freedom for a Careful Planning. Mumbad Stage 24 swapped an Into the Depths for Out of the Ashes. FFG F7 Stage 13 swapped both Pelangis for two DaVincis. SanSan Stage 19: a Gordian Blade became Analog Dreamers.
